_what: What an action does to the world and how it is checked, read by src/consequence-classes.mjs. Rows are tried in order; the first whose `tools` names the tool, or whose `annotations` all hold for it, is its class. `mode` is how the class is checked: none (nothing is asked; the default for every class), confirm_now (the person's yes for exactly this action is needed first), handoff (only the person does it). A person or space turns a class on by passing `modes` { class_id: mode } to the owner; nothing here is on by default. Approvals are kept by the owner (`approvals`), never taken from the call's own words. `scope` says which input fields are shown to the person as display-only words (who receives it, how much, how public); a scope never grants anything. Bounds are in characters.

approvals._what: The person's yes, kept by the owner (never read from the call): `once` covers exactly one call with the identity shown and is used up when it lets that call run; `tool` and `class` are allow-always for that tool or class until they end. Every approval has an end time no further away than max_seconds for its scope.
